name: Imperial Qiraji Regalia
label: Quest
description: Imperial Qiraji Regalia: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Arygos theorizes that the element which is born of conflicts between the Old Gods and their minions is also extremely deadly to them under the right conditions. I speak of Elementium, mortal.
Find and bring me Imperial Qiraji Regalia and the toxic element and I shall infuse weapons of great power.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You will strike them down and free us of these bonds.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Use the item well, friend. Let them feel the pain that they so dearly wish to inflict upon others.
